map.本工具用于检测（耐磨/拉伸/疲劳）服务的合法性校验，依据对应数据格式与语法规范实: This tool validates the (wear / tensile / fatigue) testing service against the corresponding data format and syntax rules in real time, locating errors; it runs entirely in the browser and uploads no data.
map.📚 深度解析：材料力学三项检测判定（耐磨/拉伸/疲劳）: 📚 Deep Dive: Three-Item Test for Material Mechanics (Wear / Tensile / Fatigue)
map.材料力学自检：按磨耗量、拉伸强度、疲劳循环三项判定: Material-mechanics self-check: judge by three items — abrasion loss, tensile strength, fatigue cycles
map.耐久评估：疲劳循环关系长期寿命: Durability assessment: fatigue cycles relate to long-term life
map.逐项判定：磨耗量≤0.08g、拉伸强度≥20MPa、疲劳循环≥1×10⁶ 次；三: Item-by-item: abrasion loss ≤ 0.08 g, tensile strength ≥ 20 MPa, fatigue cycles ≥ 1×10⁶; all three satisfied = pass. High abrasion shortens life; insufficient strength breaks; insufficient fatigue fails early.
map.磨耗 0.06g（≤0.08 ✓）、拉伸强度 22MPa（≥20 ✓）、疲劳 1: Abrasion 0.06 g (≤0.08 ✓), tensile strength 22 MPa (≥20 ✓), fatigue 1.2×10⁶ cycles (≥1×10⁶ ✓): all three pass → qualified. If abrasion rises to 0.09 g it fails, insufficient wear resistance.
map.20MPa 为橡胶/弹性体等软材料示例下限（金属常以百 MPa 计）；须按材料类: 20 MPa is an example lower limit for soft materials like rubber/elastomers (metals are often hundreds of MPa); set the pass line by material type — do not compare across classes.
map.为在给定应力幅下循环至失效的示例下限；实际寿命随载荷谱变化，须按 S-N 曲线与: It is an example lower limit for cycles to failure at a given stress amplitude; actual life varies with load spectrum — set by S–N curve and safety factor.
map.疲劳试验需模拟实际工况载荷谱: Fatigue tests require simulating the actual-service load spectrum
map.关于「检测（耐磨/拉伸/疲劳）服务」: About the Wear / Tensile / Fatigue Testing Service
map.材料耐磨性、拉伸强度、疲劳性能三项检测工具，依据GB/T 1689、GB/T 5: A three-item testing tool for material wear resistance, tensile strength, and fatigue performance, judging pass/fail per standards such as GB/T 1689, GB/T 528, GB/T 1688. Suitable for comprehensive mechanical-property testing of rubber, plastics, and other flexible materials.
